text: On May 13, 2024, the applicant submitted applications to the City for an Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment to permit the development of a 56-storey mixed-use building containing 407 dwelling units and 272.2 square metres of commercial space at grade located at 2346 Yonge Street. At the December 17, 2024 meeting of City Council, Council adopted City Staff's recommendation to refuse the applications and to authorize City Staff to use mediation, conciliation or other dispute resolution techniques in an attempt to resolve the applications. On January 10, 2025, the applicant appealed City Council's refusal of the applications to the Ontario Land Tribunal. The Ontario Land Tribunal held the first Case Management Conference on April 8, 2025. A three-week hearing has been scheduled to commence on October 6, 2025.
